title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.0 Release Candidate 1
summary: Version 1.0.0 Release Candidate 1 is the first versioned candidate built from the aggressively cleaned, MWB-only repository. The established Mouse Without Borders engine and the portable features proven through Test 12 remain intact; this release candidate is intended for the final real-PC validation pass before 1.0.0 stable.
changes: Promotes the product version from the 0.1 test series to 1.0.0-rc.1.
Builds directly from the cleaned repository containing only Mouse Without Borders, its unit tests, focused automation, documentation, and required legal notices.
Removes more than 8,500 unrelated PowerToys files and the retired PowerToys solution, modules, service project, native module interface, installers, and build machinery.
Keeps the one-file portable and optional self-install experience established in the Test 12 build.
Keeps the repaired, case-sensitive security-key Apply path and twelve-character generated keys.
Keeps the simplified tray menu, opaque portable About window, green classic icon, Wrap mouse default-off behavior, and resizable modeless Diagnostic Log.
Adds a repository-layout validation step so removed PowerToys trees cannot accidentally return.
Updates the user, development, maintenance, security, contribution, and extraction documentation for the MWB-only repository layout.
Preserves the complete upstream license and attribution record.
testing: Open About and confirm the displayed product version is 1.0.0-rc.1.
Run the same RC1 EXE on both computers and confirm mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, reconnect, and key matching.
Confirm an existing adjacent MouseWithoutBorders.prefs.json is loaded without losing the saved key, layout, or options.
Test a clean first launch in portable mode and confirm the preferences file is created beside the EXE.
Test Install for me, desktop and Start Menu shortcuts, the Start with Windows toggle, portable-to-installed preferences migration, and Uninstall.
Open and resize Diagnostic Log while Settings remains responsive, and confirm the actual security key is not displayed.
Confirm the green icon at small and large sizes and the simplified tray menu in both portable and installed modes.
Retest firewall prompting and sleep/wake reconnection on real Windows computers before promoting RC1 to 1.0.0 stable.
